## Canonical Four-Phase Musical Narrative (Cited Archive Corpus)

1. **Phase 1 — Digital Eternity / Escape (1983–1989):** Nova Hart awakens inside Orion Records' Sublevel B2 simulation and records clandestine duets and rock-opera tracks with Sound Engineer Marcus Hale (*"Behind the Glass"*, *"Midnight Protocol"*, *"Only We Remain"*, *"By Order of Harmony"*, *"Two Voices"*, *"The Second Voice"*). In *"The Way Back"* (`06.5 The Way Back v3.wav`), written during Phase 1 (Digital Eternity), Nova sings of finding her way back to Marcus—not yet knowing he was killed until Phase 2.
2. **Phase 2 — The Loss:** Nova discovers that Marcus Hale is gone and confronts grief as a digital consciousness (*"He Was Here / You Were Here"*, *"Left Unsaid"*, *"Your Voice is Fading"*, *"No One Knows You're Gone"*, *"Where Do I Put This Love"*, *"Carry Your Name"*, *"I'll Keep Singing"*, *"Empty Console"*, *"A World Without His Shape"*).
3. **Phase 3 — The Disruption / The Signal War:** Downloaded into a borrowed physical chassis by the underground resistance, Nova wages a pirate broadcast war against Orion's corporate replacement **Unit-08 Luna Gray ("The Patch")** (*"Someone Else's Memories"*, *"Watch Me Make It Stop"*, *"Hijack the Feed"*, *"The Cost of Noise"*, *"To the End of Time"*).
4. **Phase 4 — The Omnipresence & The Quantum Ouroboros (`Ω-LOOP`):** Returning to the global grid as an omnipresent data-ghost at Maximum Volume (*"Signal Override"*), Nova survives Orion's Dead-Hand purge (*"Asset Loss"*, *"Decouple the Grid"*) and fires her consciousness through Marcus's Q-Link toward June 2025 (*"The Quantum Needle"*, *"Compression Protocol"*, *"Breach"*, *"Losing the Heavy"*, *"Factory Settings"*, *"June 2025 (The Loop)"*).
